remarks: Be the first to live in this beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment on the second floor of a charming Colonial-style two-family home. Enjoy an open floor plan with modern finishes, central air, in-unit laundry, recessed lighting, and a spa-like bathroom with floor-to-ceiling tile. Tucked away on a quiet dead-end street just steps from Christiano Park with tennis and pickleball courts. The location is unbeatable-just a 5 minute drive to Greenwich Avenue, where you'll find world-class restaurants, boutique shopping, and a vibrant social scene. Commuters will love being only moments away from Greenwich Train Station, offering a quick and convenient ride into Manhattan. Enjoy the charm and energy of downtown Greenwich living with everything you need right at your fingertips. Owner pays water, landscaping, and snow removal. Tenant pays for gas heat, electric AC, and all other utilities. No pets allowed. Full rental application required.
